description: Add 'Cigna Health Spring' to the list of insurance companies in LibreHealth EHR. The details are provided in a file on the desktop (~/Desktop/new_carrier_info.txt). Log in with admin/password, navigate to the Practice/Administration settings for Insurance Companies, and add the new carrier with the exact Name, Address, Phone, and Payer ID (CMS ID) provided. Do not modify any existing carriers.
